subject.title: fix: beta releases require manual reruns after plugin publication

question: Should beta publication be allowed to complete as beta-live while plugin npm and ClawHub convergence continue asynchronously, rather than retaining the prior blocking ecosystem-complete contract?
rationale: This is an intentional release-operator policy change, not a mechanical correctness choice; it changes what a successful beta release means and when operators must monitor or repair the plugin ecosystem.

options.title: Approve detached beta convergence
options.body: After the two code blockers are fixed, accept beta-live as a valid beta completion state while continuation tooling owns bounded plugin npm and ClawHub convergence.

options.title: Keep ecosystem convergence blocking
options.body: Require plugin npm and ClawHub convergence before beta publication reports success, preserving the former single completion contract.

recommendation.title: Approve detached beta convergence
recommendation.body: After the two code blockers are fixed, accept beta-live as a valid beta completion state while continuation tooling owns bounded plugin npm and ClawHub convergence.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows steipete authored the beta-release orchestration and completion-state changes requiring a release-policy decision.
